richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Orai

c: Orai is the headquarters of Jalaun district in Bundelkhand, a dry, rocky part of Uttar Pradesh where summer heat is severe and water is scarce. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Orai for schools, colleges, district and police grounds, residential colonies and the municipal board's parks. We build our machines at the Vasai factory, about 1000 km away.

Machines reach Bundelkhand by road, and our installation team or a dealer in north India fixes them on site. A dry region suits an outdoor gym well. The machines need no watering and only a firm base, so a bare plot can become a usable fitness corner. Summers are very hot and winters cold, so we plan the site with afternoon shade and good morning sun.

richText.heading: Turning a bare plot into a fitness corner

items.q: Can an outdoor gym be built on a bare, rocky plot?
items.a: Yes. A concrete or paver pad is enough, and each machine is grouted into a level footing. No lawn or watering is needed.

items.q: How do we make the gym usable in Bundelkhand's summer?
items.a: Plant trees or add a pergola for afternoon shade, use light-coloured paving and encourage early morning and evening use.

items.q: Do you deliver to Jalaun district?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai, and our installation team or a dealer in north India fixes the machines after you approve the layout and quote.
